written: 2026-10-15, after the Phase250 generic repairs (arm R) and after curriculum B was written; from R's failures on spent development sets only (Phase248 dev, held-out 1 and 2; Phase249 real sets 1 and 2). Drives arm C. Tier T1/T2-development: every set here has informed code before.
runs: R on: phase248 journey-dev 16, journey-heldout 16, journey-heldout2 16, phase249 real set 1 31, real set 2 22

gaps.kind: need stated as a problem, not a feature
gaps.cause: misunderstood language (vocabulary lists desired outcomes, users describe what goes wrong)
examples: held-out h07: 'pale on one side and burnt on the other' (even_browning)
held-out2 k09: 'toast with stripes and dark patches'
held-out2 k02: 'so nothing is half raw' (cooking_evenness)
held-out2 k08: 'my shots vary a lot' (shot_consistency)
held-out2 k11: 'gets so hot outside that I worry about burns' (hot_exterior)
held-out h04: 'I hate cleaning things' (low_maintenance)
gaps.repair: teach each need's problem vocabulary (failure states, complaints), not only its goal words; counterexamples where the same words mean something else

examples: held-out h01: 'I'm on my own most evenings' (cook_single_portion)
held-out2 k01: 'cooking dinner for just myself'

held-out2 k10: 'crumpets and chunky homemade bread' (thick_bread_fit)
held-out h02: 'we often cook two things at once'
